thread:
emily: Postmortem published for the Dedicated pool autoscaler outage. Doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/postmortems/2148765432-dedicated-autoscaler-outage

TL;DR: The autoscaler misinterpreted the burst policy 'max_share' as an absolute GPU count instead of a fraction. Result: dedicated pools were capped during burst events → abrupt capacity shortfall → elevated latency and fallback routing for some Dedicated customers between 02:12–02:38 UTC. No customer data was lost, but degraded latency and a ~3% error increase for affected routes.

Action items, owners, and checkpoints below. We're running a 30m sync today at 16:00 UTC to align on the rollback & fix plan — please skim the doc before the call and add comments on the doc if you see anything missing.

ops-bot: Incident ticket #INC-214876 (https://incidents.redwood/INC-214876) — status: resolved -> follow-up tasks created.

maya: Thanks. Quick Q — any evidence this propagated to Dedicated Private deployments? Also, +1 for immediate canary before full rollout.

jonah: I'll own the autoscaler patch. Root cause: unit mismatch in the burst policy math. Opening PR to convert percentages to pool-size-corrected values and adding unit tests. ETA: patch + tests by EOD today.

snippet of problematic code:
```
# incorrect: treating 0.2 as 0.2 GPUs
max_additional_gpus = int(config.max_share)
# should be
max_additional_gpus = math.ceil(config.max_share * pool_size)
```

sara: I'll take canary orchestration and regression harness. Plan: run canary on staging + one Dedicated pool in prod with 10% traffic for 2h, validate latency & error metrics. Need an owners list for runbook steps.

alex: I'll update the rollback runbook and prepare a temporary routing weight script to reduce traffic to affected pools if we see regression during rollout. Can be executed manually; script location: s3://infra-scripts/autoscaler-rollbacks/2148765432.sh. Will have it ready in ~2h.

emily: Owners summary: jonah — autoscaler codefix & tests; sara — canary + regression; alex — rollback/runbook + routing script. Checkpoints: 1) Patch merged & staged by EOD (owner: jonah). 2) Canary in prod tomorrow 10:00 UTC (owner: sara). 3) Runbook updated and tested before wide rollout (owner: alex). 30-day follow-ups in the postmortem: add autoscaler invariants to CI, improved telemetry on burst events, and a retro in eng-all-hands.

If you can't make the 16:00 UTC sync please react with :raised_hand: or ping me directly. Otherwise see you there. :calendar:

maya: :thumbsup: I'll join the sync and bring metric dashboards.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: New PR opened by jonah -> https://git.internal.redwood/pulls/9876 (autoscaler: fix percentage -> pool conversion).

jonah: PR linked. Will request reviews from eng-runtime and eng-sre. Tagging @maya for test matrix.

sara: I'll add the test checklist to the postmortem doc and link smoke dashboards.

alex: Acknowledged. I'll rehearse the rollback script in staging and post results in this thread.

emily: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turn. We'll publish a follow-up note after the 16:00 sync with concrete timelines and any adjustments to owners/checkpoints. :sparkles:
